title: Lentor Modern — 85% sold in Phase 1
body: Remaining 2-bed units from $1.68M. 3-bed dual-key layouts still available. Developer extending early-bird discount until 30 June.

title: ABSD rates held in June 2026 review
body: No changes to Additional Buyer Stamp Duty. Foreigners remain at 60%, entities at 65%. PR first-home stays at 5%, second at 30%.

title: Rental index up 2.1% in Q2 2026
body: URA flash estimate shows continued recovery. Core Central Region leading at +2.8%. Outside Central Region +1.7%. Landed +1.9%.

title: Chuan Park relaunch — pricing leaked
body: Expected PSF $2,400–$2,600. 916 units over two 24-storey towers. Preview expected mid-June. Agent briefing 12 June.

title: CEA enforcement: unlicensed marketing
body: Three agents fined for unlicensed property ads on Carousell. All listings must show CEA registration number.

title: Mortgage rates: 3M SORA at 3.42%
body: Major banks holding 3-year fixed at ~3.55%. Expect slight easing in Q3. Forward rates suggest 3.1% by year-end.
